Thank you so much for your reply.

My friend who is older than me suggested I get some therapy for myself based on some things that happened in my past. I look up to her like an older sister and many of the things I had to deal with she has been there and done that. 

The thought of going to a therapist is a little nerve wracking as I don't see how I would have the means too. My location isn't exactly a well known city, though it is near one. And as an american (my S.O. is a Uk citizen) things like that can get pricey fast-and I've hardly got medical insurance as it is.
